title: Number of Subarrays With LCM Equal to K
goal: Count subarrays whose least common multiple is exactly k.
strategy: Extend each start with a rolling LCM computed using GCD. LCM only gains factors, so stop once it no longer divides k; no longer extension can return to the target.
